name: gatekeeper
title: Permissions
description: Restricted sessions: session profiles (where they apply, what they may do) and a gatekeeper that holds the bot identities (GitHub App, Slack bot, Linear, Sentry) and performs only the actions a session's profile grants — merges, reverts and alert-rule changes only on an operator's word, checked by Slack user id. Off by default; Full sessions are untouched.
